notes.title: Barn Finders Winter Event
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, fellow Barn Finders! 🌟[/h1]
The long-awaited Winter Event has finally landed, and boy, do we have an adventure for you. Buckle up your space boots, grab your Upgrade Gun, and let’s dive into the cosmic madness of this year’s holiday escapade!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/79d3334d83dc22ac3a7aa016d42a6c9d282dfe1d.gif[/img]
[h2]A Brief History of the Alien Devin's Holiday Mishaps[/h2]
Every December, our beloved alien pal Devin finds himself in a galactic pickle. The story’s always the same: Devin gets into a massive pre-Christmas fight with his family, they jet off to the Moon, and Devin stays behind in their space mansion.
But what’s Christmas without a little chaos? Enter the usual suspects: a thieving duo—one crafty, the other, let’s just say... lacking in brain cells—attempting to rob Devin blind. Normally, Devin, a genius in a kid’s costume, would set traps to outwit these dim-witted burglars.
This year, however, things are different. Devin downed a whole bottle of his parents’ finest moonshine and—surprise, surprise—he’s in no shape to handle the situation. Desperate for help, he’s called in none other than Buttson. Together, with your help, it’s time to lay traps, protect the loot, and save Christmas! 🎄

[h2]What Awaits You in the Winter Event?[/h2]
Here’s what you’ll be doing in this wacky holiday showdown:
[h3]Trap Building Mayhem[/h3]
[list]
[*] 5 Trap Locations: Devin’s house has five prime spots where traps need to be set.
[*] Choose the Right Trap: Use your trusty Upgrade Gun to select the perfect trap for each location.
[*] Brain Teasers Galore: Not every trap works in every spot—choose carefully, or risk a burglar breakthrough!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/dd51cd89b8a812e99d1151e961a693894f273ce8.gif[/img]
[h3]Holiday Loot Galore![/h3]
This event is packed with rewards that will make your pawn shop the talk of the galaxy:
[list]
[*] Brand New Items to collect and sell.
[*] Festive Decorations to deck out your pawn shop in holiday style.
[*] Exclusive Skins for your tools and gadgets.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/a92248d5c06b7938e8901e33d6289b894dc8fd7e.gif[/img]
[b]And, of course, a mystery reward for completing the event that Devin swears is “worth more than moon rocks!”[/b]

[h2]Limited-Time Fun! Don’t Miss Out![/h2]
Remember, this event is cyclical—meaning it won’t return for a full year! If you’re itching to protect Devin’s house and claim those juicy rewards, now’s the time to dive in. Don’t wait until next year to see what all the buzz is about!

[h2]Thank You for an Amazing Year![/h2]
From the bottom of our intergalactic hearts, thank you for supporting Barn Finders throughout the year. Your love and enthusiasm keep us going!
We wish you all a [b]Merry Christmas[/b], a [b]Happy New Year[/b], and a holiday season filled with laughter, loot, and lots of traps! See you in-game!
[u][b]The Barn Finders Team 🛸[/b][/u]

Curious about what’s happening in other amazing productions? Check out Family Land - Farmer Simulator!🌾
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2334600/Family_Land__Farmer_Simulator/

notes.title: Twilit of the Livin' Pumpks Festival 🎃
notes.content:
[h1]Howdy, Barn Finders![/h1]

It’s that spooky time of year again, and we’ve cooked up something extra special to get you in the Halloween spirit! 🎃👻 Get ready to dive headfirst into our new Twilit of the Livin' Pumpks Festival! It’s all tricks, treats, and some seriously good loot that’ll make your barn the envy of all the ghosties and ghoulies out there. 👀

[h2]Trick-or-Treat Time: Where the Pumpkins At? 🎃🔦🍬[/h2]
First up—the pumpkins! 🎃 These special Halloween pumpkins are scattered across the game world, but here’s the trick: you can’t just walk up and grab ‘em. Nope! You’ll need your trusty flashlight to make these sneaky pumpkins appear. 🔦✨ Shine that light, find the pumpkins, and snag yourself some Halloween candy currency! 🍬🍫
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/c8faf4cc2c55b87316c58df8b940f5cebdc1db11.gif[/img]
What’s the candy for? Let’s just say it might be handy for some surprises we’ve got brewing. Stay tuned, folks! 👀

[h2]Pawn Shop Makeover: Go Full Spooky 🏚️🎃[/h2]
Ever wanted to give your pawn shop a spooky facelift? Now’s your chance! For this event, you can decorate your shop with brand-new Halloween-themed wallpapers. And that’s not all—your vehicle gets in on the action, too, with new Halloween paint jobs! 🚗🎨 Whether it’s pumpkin orange or ghostly white, you’ve got creepy options to show off your Halloween style.

And don’t forget about those Halloween posters—slap 'em up on your walls and let everyone know who the true Halloween King (or Queen) is! 👑🖼️🎃
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/73d7c0094afa5f698f26dbcc1a736381eb3d02ba.gif[/img]
[h3]Tool Skins: Grit Meets Glamor 🔧🎨[/h3]
For a limited time, you can also collect Halloween-themed tool skins! 🕸️🎃 Imagine your wrench decked out in cobwebs and pumpkins, with just a hint of the undead. Who knew fixing barns could look so spooktacular? 🔧✨
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/777283f6e8b1a17d41fa0608c37eb83ff1114435.png[/img]
[h2]Thank You to Our Community! 💖🙏[/h2]
Before we sign off, we want to give a huge shoutout to our amazing community. 🙌 Your support keeps us going, and we love bringing you these updates. But don’t think we’re done yet—2024’s got more surprises in store! 💥

[b]Until then, happy pumpkin hunting, and we’ll see y’all in the barnyard! 🎃👻[/b]

If you're looking for more great games, check out Family Land - Farmer Simulator Prologue 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185480/Family_Land__Farmer_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Barn Finders - The "Quick Picker" Update! 🧤🐔
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Barn Finders![/h1]
We've got some exciting news for you. Our latest update introduces a brand-new tool: the Quick Picker! But, of course, this is Barn Finders, so getting your hands on this nifty tool won't be that simple. Remember how you had to face off against the chicken team in basketball to snag those speed boots? Well, the chickens are back, and this time, they’re ready to play... baseball! 🥎🐓
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/ddfe9e9ab7e28af43cae69f1c000719e7dcac50b.gif[/img]

[h2]The Challenge: Baseball Showdown with the Chickens![/h2]
To earn the Quick Picker, you'll need to step up to the plate and defeat our feathery friends in a high-stakes baseball match. Think you've got what it takes to outplay the chickens? You better hope so, because this tool is going to be a game-changer for all you dedicated junk hunters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/d9f206e7ba2f017f7558e385ad62f53264ca0e1b.gif[/img]

[h2]What is the Quick Picker?[/h2]
The Quick Picker is a specialized glove that allows you to pick up more than one resource at a time from the ground. It's going to make your scavenging trips way more efficient. But wait, there's more! The Quick Picker comes with three upgrade levels. Each upgrade increases the glove’s range, allowing you to scoop up resources from a wider area.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/44e089a9cb015a447b964e5d2421d3579a11fa3a.gif[/img]
[h2]Why You Need It[/h2]
With the Quick Picker in your arsenal, you’ll be able to gather resources faster and repair those hidden gems in record time. That means more items on your pawnshop shelves and more cash in your pocket! 💰

[h2]Thank You, Barn Finders Community![/h2]
[b]As always, we want to say a huge THANK YOU to all our fans. Your support is the reason this game continues to grow and thrive. We hope you enjoy this latest update, and we can’t wait to see you challenge the chickens once more!
Happy hunting! 🕵️‍♂️
[/b]

notes.title: The Thrill of Auctions and Hidden Treasures
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, Barn Finders![/h1]

Today, we’re diving into one of the most exciting aspects of Barn Finders—the auction mechanic and the intriguing variety of storage units you can discover.

[h2]Auction Mechanics: How It Works[/h2]
In Barn Finders, auctions are where the real action begins. You’ll compete against other bidders to win abandoned storage units that could hold untold treasures... or just a bunch of junk! The thrill of the auction lies in the mystery—you can only see a portion of what’s inside before making your bid. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/97349e4990274dfae9d0613382a3bd2f39ba75d9.gif[/img]
[h1]Unique Storage Units: From Pirate Treasures to Mysterious Spaces[/h1]
But what makes these auctions even more exciting are the unique and themed storage units you’ll come across. Imagine walking into a storage unit filled with pirate-themed decor—could there be an ancient chest filled with gold?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/78c89cd1f145a92e6f5f4f9e6c8fa5dd9c58dfeb.gif[/img]
Or perhaps you find yourself staring at what seems to be an empty unit, with just a few dusty boxes and an old ladder. Don’t be fooled; even the most unassuming spaces can hold the rarest items! Each unit is a gamble, and that’s what makes every auction a heart-pounding experience.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/e9da6cb2353ee2ca14cd5a59277c1b13dbb34e6e.gif[/img]
[b][h2]Have You Checked Out the New SuperHero Map?[/h2][/b]
Speaking of exciting new content, have you explored the new SuperHero Map yet? It’s a free addition packed with new adventures and items to discover. If you haven’t checked it out, now’s the perfect time!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34344567/8be9de2d9465e8f3e84473a82dfea1450d3c0d92.png[/img]
[b]Bonus: New Car Dealer Simulator Teaser
Before we wrap up, we’re thrilled to share that our colleagues have just released a brand-new teaser for their upcoming game, Car Dealer Simulator! Be sure to visit their Steam page and get a sneak peek at what’s in store.[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

Thanks for reading, and happy bidding, Barn Finders!

We would like to introduce you to the newest update to the Barn Finders, which except many bug fixes contains also two new mechanics - Chicken Sonar and Clients selling items.

If you ever had a problem with finding the last one item on the map (who the hell hid them there, right?) - this is a tool for you. Just press and hold button and then release, and the Sonar will inform you if there is any item in your area. As simple as that. You still have to look for it, but it sure makes it a lot easier. Right outside your pawnshop we put a small little stand. From now on, from time to time, some of the Clients will go there and offer you an item they want to get rid of. You can haggle to get an even better price, before you sell it in your own shop! Just remember - stands open after you finish Aunt’s Marry map - after that it’s all yours to profit from!
